clue.text: Film director cut up an item of sports equipment

indicators.note: in a down light, up tells us to read the word for cut from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to lop is to cut off
a ski is a piece of sports kit

explanation.surface: A movie director has sawn a piece of sports gear into bits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns LOP into POL. Roman Polanski is the director.
explanation.definitionFit: Roman Polanski is a well-known film-maker, so the name is an example of the category.

clue.text: Divine companion upset coddled creature

indicators.note: in a down light, upset means turned upside down, so the two words are read from the bottom up

parts.note: the Divine is God
a pal is a companion

explanation.surface: A heavenly companion is put out by a pampered animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns GODPAL into the answer, read upwards in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: A pampered pet dog kept on the lap is the classic coddled animal.

clue.text: Better form of gas meter

indicators.note: a new form of the words means their letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone describes a new type of gas meter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Better' looks like an adjective, but it is one who bets.
explanation.definitionFit: A gambler is someone who places bets, i.e. a better.

clue.text: Spoil lettuce that's planted

parts.note: cos is a variety of lettuce
set means placed or planted in the ground

explanation.surface: A gardener worries about ruining the lettuce that was put in.
explanation.definitionFit: To pamper or indulge someone is to spoil them.

clue.text: Work hard to get a new motto

parts.note: to slog is to toil

explanation.surface: An office grind is needed to come up with a fresh catchphrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A motto is a catchphrase or rallying phrase, a synonym.

clue.text: Issue about drug that's exactly right

indicators.note: the word for issue goes round the drug, so about signals one piece placed around another

parts.note: issue means offspring, such as a son
pot is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: A dispute concerning narcotics is said to be precisely correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Issue' reads as a problem, but it means offspring.
explanation.definitionFit: Something accurate to the dot is perfectly correct, an idiom.

clue.text: Garment is to hang loosely round boy

indicators.note: the sagging word goes round the boy's name, so round signals containment

parts.note: to sag is to droop or hang loosely
Ron is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A piece of clothing drapes slackly around a lad.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrap of cloth worn round the waist in South-East Asia is an item of clothing.

clue.text: Upper classes make good with admission

parts.note: entry means admission or being let in

explanation.surface: The aristocracy do well by letting people in.
explanation.definitionFit: The landed people just below the nobility form the upper social classes.

clue.text: Former pupil's only trace is out of date

parts.note: OB is old boy, a former pupil; the possessive adds no letter
sole means only
a scent is a trace left behind

explanation.surface: All that remains of an old boy is something outdated.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'pupil's' stands for 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something becoming obsolete is going out of date, a synonym.

clue.text: Cry of pain stifled by eccentric dramatist

indicators.note: the cry is smothered inside the eccentric, so it sits within that word

parts.note: a card is an eccentric or amusing person
ow is what you cry when hurt

explanation.surface: An oddball playwright muffles a yelp of pain.
explanation.walkthrough: Noël Coward was an English playwright.
explanation.definitionFit: Noël Coward wrote plays such as Private Lives, so he is an example of a playwright.

clue.text: Benefit provided except in Crosby

indicators.note: the word for except sits inside the singer's first name

parts.note: Bing Crosby was the American crooner
less means minus, except

explanation.surface: A singer's advantage comes with a condition.
explanation.definitionFit: A boon or advantage is a benefit, a synonym.

clue.text: Deer takes one for a ride

explanation.definitionFit: Female deer are hinds' kin in the plural; and to diddle someone is to swindle them.

clue.text: Writes for politician producing dark tale

parts.note: to ghost is to write on behalf of someone else
a Tory is a British Conservative politician

explanation.surface: Someone ghostwrites for an MP and produces a grim narrative.
explanation.definitionFit: A spooky story about spirits is a kind of dark tale.

clue.text: One way to make underwear stretch

parts.note: a singlet is a sleeveless vest worn as underwear
to rack is to stretch, as on the rack

explanation.surface: A tip on how to make your vest longer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One way' looks like a vague phrase but means a single-lane road or railway.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow road or railway carrying traffic in only one lane is a single route, i.e. one way.

clue.text: Happy accepting permit in Scotland

indicators.note: the word for happy takes in the word for permit, holding it inside

parts.note: gay in its old sense means merry or happy
allow means permit

explanation.surface: Someone cheerful agrees to grant leave north of the border.
explanation.walkthrough: Galloway is a region in south-west Scotland; the definition is a place found there.
explanation.definitionFit: Galloway is a historic region of south-west Scotland, so it is a place located there.

clue.text: A demonic form of entertainer

indicators.note: a new form of the letters means they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fiendish style of performer.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand-up comic is a kind of entertainer.

clue.text: Ambled unsteadily into pandemonium

indicators.note: walking unsteadily suggests the letters lurch into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone staggered drunkenly into chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: The name of a London asylum came to mean uproar and chaos, a synonym.

clue.text: European's elegance

explanation.definitionFit: A native of Poland is a European, and refinement is also called this word.

clue.text: Politician, soldier and landlord

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, standing for a soldier
a publican is the landlord of a pub

explanation.surface: A list of three people: a politician, a soldier and a pub landlord.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the US Republican Party is a politician.

clue.text: In June Venetian weather is erratic

indicators.note: the answer is held in the run of letters in these two words

explanation.surface: Venice weather in June is unpredictable.
explanation.definitionFit: Irregular or not steady describes something erratic, a synonym.

clue.text: Dicky Monroe is dead!

indicators.note: dicky is British slang for faulty or shaky, so the letters are out of order

explanation.surface: An exclamation that Marilyn Monroe has died.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dicky' looks like a name next to Monroe, but it means unreliable.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying someone exists no longer is a way of saying they have died, an idiom.

clue.text: On reflection condemn low spirits

indicators.note: a reflection in a mirror shows the word back to front

parts.note: to doom is to condemn

explanation.surface: Thinking it over, someone damns a state of gloom.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in a sulk is to be in low spirits, a sense of the word.

clue.text: Athlete gets evangelist ornamental mineral

parts.note: a Blue is a sportsperson who represented Oxford or Cambridge
John is one of the four Gospel writers

explanation.surface: A sportsman acquires a gospel writer and a decorative stone.
explanation.walkthrough: Blue John is a banded fluorite from Derbyshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue John is a purple-banded fluorite used for vases and jewellery, an example.

clue.text: Wild and free in the capital

parts.note: mad means wild
to rid is to free

explanation.surface: Running wild and loose in the city.
explanation.definitionFit: Madrid is the capital of Spain, an example of a capital city.

clue.text: Bacchante's crazy about another woman

indicators.note: the word for crazy goes around the woman's name

parts.note: mad means crazy
Ena is a woman's name; another because the Bacchante is a woman too

explanation.surface: A wild female reveller is mad about a different woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A maenad was a frenzied female follower of Bacchus, the same as a Bacchante.

clue.text: Raise the matter of British fish

parts.note: a roach is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Bringing up the subject of a fish from Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring up a topic is to raise it for discussion, a synonym.
